title: Setup
subtitle: What your business needs before it starts working. Each item is read from your data – complete it on the linked screen.
pendingNotice: Your business is being set up. Until it is activated, only Administration and My account are available.
activeNotice: Your business is active. If an item goes missing later, only the action that needs it is blocked.
loadError: The setup could not be loaded.

branding.title: Logo and brand colour
branding.description: The main logo is uploaded and the brand colour is set.

vat_and_rounding.title: VAT and rounding
vat_and_rounding.description: The VAT rate (and, when VAT-registered, the VAT number) and cash rounding.

bank_account.title: Bank account
bank_account.description: A validated IBAN or QR-IBAN account is chosen as the default account.

number_ranges.title: Number ranges confirmed
number_ranges.description: You have checked and confirmed the number ranges. They freeze at activation.

location_opening_hours.title: Location with opening hours
location_opening_hours.description: At least one active location has opening hours.

users.title: Users invited
users.description: At least one manager is active – in a one-person business, you are enough.

publishing_profile.title: Publishing profile
publishing_profile.description: Description, legal notice and lead routing.

blocks.invoice_issue: If it goes missing after activation, invoices are blocked
blocks.numbered_document: If it goes missing after activation, numbered documents are blocked
blocks.marketplace_publishing: If it goes missing after activation, marketplace publishing is blocked

legal.title: Terms of Service and data processing
legal.intro: By activating, you accept the current version of both documents on behalf of the business.
legal.unavailable: The documents are not published yet. Contact Nexotec support.
legal.notFinal: Activation waits for the final versions of the documents (version 1.0).

activate.title: Activate business
activate.intro: Read both documents and accept them on behalf of the business.
activate.accept: I have read “{{title}}” (version {{version}}) and accept it on behalf of the business.
activate.freezeWarning: Activation freezes every number range. After that only Nexotec support can change them, with a reason.
activate.error: The business could not be activated.
activate.documentsError: The documents could not be loaded.

inProgress.title: Business is being set up
inProgress.body: Your business is being set up. As soon as its management activates it, every area becomes available to you.

acceptance.title: New version of the legal documents
acceptance.intro: There is a new version of the Terms of Service or the Data Processing Agreement. Please read and accept it on behalf of the business.
acceptance.dueBy: Please accept by {{date}} at the latest. After that, managers reach only this screen; your colleagues keep working.
acceptance.held: The deadline has passed. Until you accept, only this screen is available.
acceptance.error: The acceptance could not be saved.
acceptance.done: Thank you – the current version is accepted.

platform.title: Legal documents
platform.subtitle: Terms of Service and Data Processing Agreement, versioned per language. A published version is never changed – a correction is a new version.
platform.loadError: The legal documents could not be loaded.

publish.title: Publish a new version
publish.versionHint: One to three dotted numbers, e.g. 1.0. Below 1.0 a version is a draft.
publish.error: The version could not be published.

refusals.legal_acceptance_missing: Accept the current Terms of Service and Data Processing Agreement first.
refusals.legal_document_empty: A legal document needs a title and a text.
refusals.legal_document_not_current: Only the current version of a document can be accepted. Reload the page.
refusals.legal_document_version_exists: This version already exists in this language.
refusals.legal_document_version_invalid: A version is one to three dotted numbers, e.g. 1.0.
refusals.legal_document_version_not_newer: A new version must be later than the newest published one.
refusals.legal_documents_not_final: Activation waits for the final versions of the legal documents (version 1.0).
refusals.legal_documents_unavailable: The legal documents are not published yet.
refusals.manager_only: A manager of this business does this.
refusals.setup_checklist_incomplete: The checklist is not complete yet.
refusals.setup_checklist_item_missing: A setup item is missing: “{{item}}”. Complete it under Administration › Setup.
